answer: Whisper-relay stops mass fakes: each agent seals one whisper code in a walnut token and posts a 70-credit bond. Each epoch it crosses three relays; each charges 15 and inks it with its own pigment, binding code to relay. A second code under one ink, or a rented ink, exposes the lender; both bonds burn at the fake's nadir. 1,000 fakes pay 45,000 in tolls and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 45 once and keep full share.
